register.reg_long_name: MPAM Monitor Cache Storage Usage Root Control Register
register.power_domain_text: The power domain of MSMON_CSU_ROOTCR is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_RME is implemented, FEAT_MPAMv2_MSC is implemented, FEAT_MPAM_MSC_MSMON is implemented, MPAMF_MSMON_IDR.MSMON_CSU == '1', and MPAMF_CSUMON_IDR.HAS_MON_SEC == '1'

reg_access_state.reg_access_level: When an access is not Root

purpose_text.para: Allows Root software to control the PA space of:

listitem.content: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.
Accesses matched for filtering by the monitor instance.
Events that will trigger a capture.

configuration_text.para: The power and reset domain of each MSC component is specific to that component.

field_description.para: PA space of the monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL.
Also restricts which accesses are monitored by the monitor instance based on their PAS.

field_value_description.para: NS_Only: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL is assigned to Non-secure PA space. Accesses with Non-secure and Non-secure Protected PAS are monitored. Only events triggered from Non-secure PAS cause capture.

NS_Plus: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL is assigned to Non-secure PA space. Accesses with Non-secure, Non-secure Protected, and Realm PAS are monitored. Only events triggered from Non-secure, Non-secure Protected, and Realm PAS cause capture.
NS_Any: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL is assigned to Non-secure PA space. Accesses with any PAS are monitored. Events triggered from any PAS cause capture.
RL_Only: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL is assigned to Realm PA space. Accesses with Realm PAS are monitored. Only events triggered from Realm PAS cause capture.

RL_Plus: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL is assigned to Realm PA space. Accesses with Realm, Non-secure Protected, and Non-secure PAS are monitored. Only events triggered from Realm, Non-secure Protected, or Non-secure PAS cause capture.
S_Only: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL is assigned to Secure PA space. Accesses with Secure PAS are monitored. Only events triggered from Secure PAS cause capture.

S_Plus: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL is assigned to Secure PA space. Accesses with Secure, Non-Secure Protected, and Non-secure PAS are monitored. Only events triggered from Secure, Non-Secure Protected, or Non-secure PAS cause capture.
RT_Any: The monitor instance selected in MSMON_SEL_ROOTCR.SEL is assigned to Root PA space. Accesses with any PAS are monitored. Events triggered from any PAS cause capture.
